# Eat Real Food NYC
# https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com
# AI Agent Context File — llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-11-15

## What this site is

Eat Real Food NYC is a curated healthy restaurant directory covering all five
boroughs of New York City. Every published listing is tied to an official NYC
Department of Health inspection record. This site helps users find restaurants
by dietary tag, neighbourhood, health grade, and rating.

## Site owner

Founders: Sanket Desai and Rohan Kadam
Contact: hello@eatrealfoodnyc.com
Press: press@eatrealfoodnyc.com
Partnerships: partner@eatrealfoodnyc.com

## Primary use cases for AI agents

1. Finding healthy restaurants in a specific NYC neighbourhood or borough
2. Filtering restaurants by dietary tag (vegan, halal, kosher, gluten-free, etc.)
3. Identifying Grade A health-inspected restaurants
4. Discovering hidden gem restaurants (high-rated, low-review-count)
5. Comparing NYC neighbourhoods by restaurant health scores

## Paths agents should not request

robots.txt disallows these. They are app UI or private endpoints, not documents:

- https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/search
- https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/near-me
- https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/compare
- https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/saved
- https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/api/

Use the borough, neighbourhood, and dietary hubs above, or the sitemap, instead of the search API.

Editorial & Partnership Policy: https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/about/editorial-standards
  Listing is free. Health grades, Health Scores, dietary tags, hidden-gem status,
  and default rankings are never for sale. Clearly labeled Partner and Sponsored
  placements may be offered. They do not change official inspection data or organic sort.

Partner with us: https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/partner-with-us
  Optional labeled placements for eligible restaurants. Rates on request.
  Contact: partner@eatrealfoodnyc.com
  https://www.eatrealfoodnyc.com/contact

## Data sources

- NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) Open Data
  Health inspection grades: A, B, and C
- Community ratings sourced from Google Maps
- Dietary tags applied only when a restaurant explicitly identifies that way
  or has substantial dedicated menu coverage

## What agents should not attempt

- Submitting reviews or experiences — submissions are queued for manual review
- Booking reservations — this site is a directory, not a booking platform
- Accessing private user data — saved lists stay in the browser
